releases.title: Now you can see what changed after every update.

entries.text: A What's New screen, shown the first time you open the app after an update.
The full release history now lives in Settings, under What's New.
Release notes are written in every language the app supports.
Clearer VoiceOver descriptions for the timer, remaining time and completed cycles.
Layouts now adapt to larger text sizes, and animations respect Reduce Motion.
Invalid timer settings now include a visible and accessible explanation.

releases.title: Hands-free control and alarms that always ring.

entries.text: Siri and Shortcuts support, so you can start, pause and reset the timer hands-free.
An alarm that rings when a session ends, even while your device is in silent mode.
Rebuilt on Swift 6, with a full unit, UI and snapshot test suite behind it.
A Pomodoro timer built in SwiftUI, with focus sessions, short breaks and long breaks.
Settings for every timer duration, saved between launches.
